title: What Is Really Going On When the Ground Shakes?
description: A friendly look at the giant puzzle pieces under our feet.
narration: What is really going on when the ground shakes? Earth's outer layer is made of giant puzzle pieces. The pieces keep slowly moving, but their rough edges get stuck. While they are stuck, energy keeps building up. Then the edges let go, and that stored energy ripples out like waves on a pond. Special instruments draw the shaking as zig-zag lines.

claims.quote: made up of giant puzzle pieces called tectonic plates

claims.sentence: The pieces keep slowly moving, but their rough edges get stuck.

claims.sentence: While they are stuck, energy keeps building up.

claims.sentence: Then the edges let go, and that stored energy ripples out like waves on a pond.
claims.quote: all that stored up energy is released. The energy radiates outward from the fault in all directions in the form of seismic waves like ripples on a pond
